title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
premise: Summer, 1922. Nick Carraway rents a cottage on Long Island next to Jay Gatsby, a mysterious millionaire whose lavish parties glitter across the bay from Nick’s cousin Daisy.

moments.title: The green light
moments.happened: Nick sees Gatsby alone at night, reaching toward a green light at the end of Daisy’s dock.
alternatives: Gatsby buys the house beside Daisy’s
Nick never moves to West Egg

moments.title: Gatsby’s party
moments.happened: Nick finally meets his host at one of the enormous parties and is drawn into his circle.

moments.title: Tea at Nick’s cottage
moments.happened: Gatsby and Daisy meet again for the first time in five years, in Nick’s small front room.
alternatives: Gatsby loses his nerve and leaves

moments.title: The Plaza Hotel
moments.happened: In a sweltering hotel suite Tom exposes Gatsby’s dealings, and Daisy won’t say she never loved Tom.
alternatives: Daisy says she never loved Tom

moments.title: The yellow car
moments.happened: Driving Gatsby’s car home, Daisy strikes Myrtle Wilson. Gatsby decides to take the blame.
alternatives: They take a different road home

moments.title: Waiting for the call
moments.happened: Gatsby waits by his pool for a call from Daisy that never comes, while George Wilson searches for the car’s owner.
alternatives: Daisy calls and they leave together
Gatsby leaves for Chicago at dawn
Nick stays with Gatsby all day

moments.title: The funeral
moments.happened: Almost no one comes to Gatsby’s funeral. Daisy and Tom have already left town.
alternatives: Gatsby’s father tells everyone his past
